title: 新股定价留余地：富兰克林邓普顿，2024年底开始活跃
speaker: Nicholas Choi

segments.en: You guys have been pretty active in this IPO market. Can you tell us how active have you been?
segments.zh: 你们在新股市场一直相当活跃。能告诉我们你们有多活跃吗？

segments.en: So, this probably takes us back since 2024. End of 2024, when the market started to become relevant again.
segments.zh: 这大概要追溯到2024年。2024年底，市场开始重新变得重要。

segments.en: The key reason why we've been active is actually it's been a very strong source of idea generation. Because you have a whole lot of new sectors, companies, those that you just ran through, that are coming to market.
segments.zh: 我们活跃的关键原因在于，它一直是想法生成的强大来源。因为有很多新板块、新公司，就像你刚才提到的那些，正在进入市场。

segments.en: That just wasn't available for us as secondary investors, secondary equity investors to invest in. So, that's been the primary motivation.
segments.zh: 这些对我们作为二级市场权益参与者来说，以前是无法参与的。所以这是主要动机。

segments.en: But at the same time, what's been obvious, I guess as you've pointed out, is the strong momentum behind some of these IPOs. And the key reason is because they haven't been priced to perfection.
segments.zh: 但与此同时，正如你指出的，一些新股背后的强劲势头很明显。关键原因是它们的定价并未完美。

segments.en: There's been money left on the table, particularly for those deals in 2024, and I guess most of 2025.
segments.zh: 市场上留有余地，尤其是2024年和2025年的大部分交易。

segments.en: And so, when you've got a strong combination of good fundamentals, these are very interesting companies, some of them leading edge, and if they come to market at a reasonable valuation,
segments.zh: 所以，当良好基本面强劲结合时，这些是非常有趣的公司，有些处于前沿，如果它们以合理估值进入市场，

segments.en: that actually provides a compelling case for us to actually do some work and go into some of these names.
segments.zh: 这实际上为我们提供了有说服力的理由去深入研究并参与其中一些标的。
